The test image shows a cut stem placed in a beaker of water with visible milky/cloudy bacterial ooze streaming down from the cut end — this is the classic "bacterial streaming test." The stem also shows internal brownish vascular discoloration. This pattern is diagnostic for bacterial wilt.

My top candidate is **Bacterial_Wilt** (Ralstonia solanacearum streaming test). Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image is a near-identical match — same setup (cut stem in water beaker), same brown vascular discoloration, same bacterial ooze streaming down. Both images are from the same Bugwood series (5606063 vs 5606065). This is definitively the bacterial streaming test for **Bacterial_Wilt**.
